text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Nggghhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"And here I was trying to close out
the year in a blaze of glory, too~!"
choice_data_list: Let's keep doing our best together.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse I did!? The King's pride
would never allow me to stay on a losing streak!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who wins at the very end is the true victor!
Next time, I'm taking center stage!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, already making a declaration of determination—classic King.
You never stay down for long, do ya?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!!
Giving up over something like that is just...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, not that I ever thought so in the first place.
Nyahaha.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Then didn't you not even need
to bring it up in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chaaan! King-chaaan!
Preparations for the live performance are starting!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it is about time.
What shall we do, King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm heading there.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If it's the last race of the year, then it's our last chance to express our gratitude to the fans this year.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Never slacking off, no matter what happens.
Now that's a true King.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Waaah, so cool~!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well then, do your best for my sake too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the stage is the other way, Sky-san!
Running away won't do you any good!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
Here we go then, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haha, why's King taking charge here?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... El plans to set off
the final fireworks of the year-deeees!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~, a grand blossom blooming in the dead of winter, is it~?
Ufufu, how wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Let's make this a stage
with no regrets left behind!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, without you even having to say it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"We were there in this year's Arima Kinen."
Let's etch that truth deep into the hearts of the fans!

"—That night, their Winning Live
proved to be the most sensational spectacle of the entire year."
